view: AP frontal (portable/supine or semi-erect) chest radiograph; L marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate for interpretation but limited: AP portable technique, scapulae overlie the upper lung fields, minimal rotation, slightly underpenetrated over the opaque right hemithorax; lung apices and both costophrenic angles included; large body habitus.

devices.location: right shoulder / right infraclavicular soft tissue
left shoulder / left infraclavicular soft tissue
left mid chest, lateral to the left heart border (lead wire descends over the left lower zone)
coursing obliquely over the right hemithorax from the right neck base down toward the right upper abdomen
lateral to the right chest wall over the right arm/flank

abnormalities.finding: Near-complete dense opacification (white-out) of the right hemithorax with ipsilateral volume loss, most consistent with right lung collapse/atelectasis (endobronchial obstruction vs post-pneumonectomy state); coexisting pleural fluid cannot be excluded
Tracheal and mediastinal (cardiac) shift toward the right, i.e. toward the opacified side
Small residual lucent areas medially at the right apex and in the medial right lower zone - residual aerated lung vs loculated air (loculated pneumothorax/hydropneumothorax component) not excluded
Right costophrenic angle and right hemidiaphragm obscured by the opacity
Compensatory hyperinflation / hyperlucency of the left lung with flattened left hemidiaphragm; left lung otherwise clear, left costophrenic angle sharp
Right heart border and cardiac size not assessable due to the right hemithorax opacity
Degenerative changes of both glenohumeral/acromioclavicular joints; no acute rib fracture identified

description_zh: 前後位（AP）胸部X光，右側胸腔幾乎完全白化，氣管與心臟縱膈向右側移位，顯示右側容積減少，符合右肺塌陷（肺不張，須考慮支氣管內阻塞或肺切除術後狀態），並不排除合併肋膜積液；僅右肺尖內側及右下肺野內側殘留少量透亮區，可能為殘餘含氣肺或局限性氣體（局限性氣胸／液氣胸）。左肺代償性過度膨脹、透亮度增加，左側肋膈角清晰，未見明確浸潤。右側橫膈與肋膈角被緻密影遮蔽，心臟大小無法評估。體表可見三個心電圖電極及導線與外部管線投影於右胸，未見胸管或引流管。
